long_biography.plain_text:
Warmington began working in the family group's Southern California division while studying at Stanford and joined full-time as a construction superintendent after graduating. He later moved into group leadership, becoming president in 2007 and chief executive the following year as the fourth generation of his family to lead the business.

When rapid growth exposed inconsistent contracts and operating practices across the group's divisions, Warmington standardised them and helped give the organisation a more unified structure. Warmington Properties now develops housing, acquires existing assets and manages multifamily and commercial property, while Warmington Residential continues the family's housebuilding activities. He also oversees related interior-design and homebuyer-technology businesses.
